description: Open a URL in the current tab and wait for the page to load (up to the pageLoadTimeoutMs set in start_browser). Returns the final URL after any redirects, and the page title. Use history to go back, forward, or refresh; use wait_for_page when a later redirect or client-side route change still has to happen.

url.description: Absolute URL including the scheme, e.g. 'https://www.saucedemo.com'.

name: navigate
